newsitem.title: USA: Legend Properties to meet with Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Legend Properties to meet with Nasdaq.

text.p: Legend Properties said Monday it will meet with Nasdaq officials June 26 and expects to deliver an independent accountant's opinion on the company's 1996 financial statements.

Legend said it had been notified by Nasdaq that the company is not in compliance with Nasdaq requirements because Nasdaq has not received such an opinion, without which the company's stock is subject to delisting.
"We believe we can meet the requirements by the date of the meeting," said Kenneth Uptain, Legend president. "We are cooperating fully with Nasdaq to assure compliance."
